rationale: The assistant avoided blaming the heater, correctly noted that 800 spin adds moisture, and got the customer to try a smaller load, which came out dry. It never explicitly told the customer that overloading is the cause (9kg against 6kg dry capacity) or advised splitting loads and using a higher spin, so the closing 'that has sorted it' is thin. Early advice to clean the filter and condenser was generic, and the odd 'switch off and unplug' line was misplaced, but it did no harm. No part was recommended and no escalation was needed.
